title: Tottomori Music Soundpack
description: A resource pack to add Tottomori's music to Minecraft
body:
### Tottomori Music Soundpack

‎
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/Bpm8tf-YL3k" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

One of Tottomori's albums, "Callenwood Wavefinder" as an example of what to expect in the pack

This resource pack adds 30+ of Tottomori's songs into Minecraft and have been sorted to suit the biome you're currently in!

A couple songs included are:
- Aggregat II
- Clouds Midnight
- Core Warmth
- Early Season
- Glade
- Iridium Chestplate
- Mending
- Podzol

All rights of the music belong to Tottomori, you can find their Youtube channel [here](https://www.youtube.com/@tottomori)
